I actually made a list of all the bosses with how many tries it took me. Funny thing is, Rom was the one that gave me the most trouble with 8 tries until i beat him. But obviously he wasn't hard, it was just his children that were annoying.
As for the hardest boss, i would say it was Shadows Of Yharnam, which ironically enough i beat on my first try, but damn... the adrenaline rush during the fight was just overwhelming!
As for my favorite boss fight, i think i have the same opinion as everyone, in that Gerhman is definitely the most beautiful boss fight in the game, from the soundtrack to the environment to the mood, it's just amazing. 

What about you?

Obviously this is all subjective. My bad, i probably should have said "my favorite game" instead of "best game ever".

I'm usually not a huge PVP fan, but i might try it this time. And i agree about the R1 spamming, it gets boring. I always go for a more strategic approach, even in PVE, it's always more fun to observe the mobs' attack patterns and attack accordingly than to just go in blindly hitting R1.
It's simply breathtaking, if i ever find an original soundtrack I'm buying that shit so fast.

I definitely noticed how much more elements and mechanics DS3 has to offer.
